approve(address,uint256).details: Non-zero to non-zero approvals are allowed, but should be used cautiously. The methods increaseAllowance + decreaseAllowance are available to prevent any front-running that may occur.

params._spender: The account permitted to spend up to `_value` amount of caller's funds.
params._value: The amount of tokens `_spender` is allowed to spend.
The amount of tokens to burn.

burnFrom(address,uint256).details: The caller must have previously been given an allowance by `_from`.

params._from: The account to burn the tokens from.
params._value: The amount of tokens to burn.

decreaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: This function will never underflow, and instead will bound allowance to 0.

params._spender: The account to decrease the allowance of.
params._sub_value: The amount to decrease the allowance by.

increaseAllowance(address,uint256).details: This function will never overflow, and instead will bound allowance to MAX_UINT256. This has the potential to grant an infinite approval.

params._add_value: The amount to increase the allowance by.
params._spender: The account to increase the allowance of.

mint(address,uint256).details: Only callable by an account with minter privileges.

params._to: The account newly minted tokens are credited to.
params._value: The amount of tokens to mint.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.details: In the event of a chain fork, replay attacks are prevented as domain separator is recalculated. However, this is only if the resulting chains update their chainId.

params._deadline: The deadline by which the signature must be submitted.
params._owner: The account which generated the signature and is granting an allowance.
params._r: The first 32 bytes of the ECDSA signature.
params._s: The second 32 bytes of the ECDSA signature.
params._spender: The account which will be granted an allowance.
params._v: The last byte of the ECDSA signature.

params._to: The account to transfer tokens to.
params._value: The amount of tokens to transfer.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: The caller needs to have an allowance from account `_from` greater than or equal to the value being transferred. An allowance equal to the uint256 type's maximum, is considered infinite and does not decrease.

params._from: The account which tokens will be spent from.
params._to: The account which tokens will be sent to.
params._value: The amount of tokens to be transferred.

approve(address,uint256).notice: Allow `_spender` to transfer up to `_value` amount of tokens from the caller's account.

permit(address,address,uint256,uint256,u.notice: Permit `_spender` to spend up to `_value` amount of `_owner`'s tokens via a signature.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).notice: Transfer tokens from one account to another.
